sn21.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kuṭāgārasalāyaṃ || || 2
sn21.7:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammikāya kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti || poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya || || 3
sn21.7:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇha samayam paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || || 4
sn21.7:2.3: Ko nu kho bhikkhave upaṭṭhānasālāyam bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyā ti || || 5
sn21.7:2.4: Āyasmā bhante Visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyāti || || 6
sn21.7:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Visākham pañcālaputtam āmantesi || ||
sn21.7:3.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ Visākha bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi || pe|| atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyā ti || || 7
sn21.7:4.2: Idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
